name: m365
description: Microsoft 365 for Claude Code and agent bots: read and search Outlook mail, calendar and free slots, Teams chats, OneDrive and people; draft, preview and send mail, schedule meetings and message Teams with a preview-digest-confirm flow and a human confirmation hook; an events poll for alerts; and a local profile that remembers your contacts and chats so 'email Mahmoud' resolves. Self-contained (no npm packages, no admin rights), browser or device-code sign-in, least-privilege scopes, optional read-only mode, OpenClaw package builder.

m365_client_id.title: Microsoft app (client) ID
m365_client_id.description: The Application (client) ID of your company's Microsoft Entra app registration for this plugin (one-time admin setup, see docs/APP_REGISTRATION.md). Not a secret. Falls back to the M365_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

m365_tenant.title: Tenant (optional)
m365_tenant.description: Entra tenant id or domain. Leave empty to use 'organizations' (any work account), which is right for most companies.

m365_auth_mode.title: Sign-in method
m365_auth_mode.description: auto (default): browser sign-in, falling back to a device code. interactive: browser only. device-code: type a short code at a Microsoft page (no browser needed on this machine).

m365_permissions.title: Permissions to request (optional)
m365_permissions.description: requested (default): ask only for what the enabled modules need; an admin may have to approve new permissions. app: use the permissions already approved for the app, for example one a bot already uses, so no new admin request is needed.

m365_refresh_token_file.title: Shared token file (optional)
m365_refresh_token_file.description: Path to a file that holds an existing refresh token from another tool's sign-in (for example a bot's). The plugin then uses that sign-in instead of asking you to sign in. Leave empty for the normal sign-in. Only a path: the token itself is never entered here.

m365_client_secret_file.title: App secret file (optional)
m365_client_secret_file.description: Path to a file holding the app's client secret, only if the app is registered with a secret (a shared token file usually needs it). Leave empty otherwise. Only a path: the secret itself is never entered here.

m365_redirect_uri.title: Sign-in redirect address (optional)
m365_redirect_uri.description: Only if the app registration allows one exact redirect address, e.g. http://localhost:8400/callback (common for an app made for a bot). The browser sign-in then uses exactly that address. Leave empty for the usual http://localhost.

m365_attach_dirs.title: Folders files may be attached from (optional)
m365_attach_dirs.description: Only files inside these folders can be attached to an email draft (separate several with ; on Windows). Leave empty to allow no local attachments. Pick a dedicated folder, never your whole user folder.

m365_signature_file.title: Email signature file (optional)
m365_signature_file.description: Path to an HTML file with your email signature. When set, drafts are sent as HTML with your signature (images next to the file are embedded). Leave empty for plain-text drafts.

m365_modules.title: Modules (optional)
m365_modules.description: Comma-separated: mail, calendar, teams, channels, people, files. Leave empty for mail, calendar, teams, people, files. 'channels' (team channel messages) needs admin consent, so it is off by default.

m365_read_only.title: Read-only mode
m365_read_only.description: When on, only read permissions are requested and no tool can change Microsoft 365 (no sending, scheduling or messaging).
